Name: (CR) Kisaa's More Hatches and Ladders
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[left][size=3]While I like them a lot, I found the swatch variety for the new 1.6 decorative hatch and ladder items extremely lacking, so I went and added more Vanilla-matching swatches myself and gave them PIF functionality. Also available for Alternative Textures without PIF functionality.﻿﻿

[/size][img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img][size=3]
[/size][/left]
[list]
[*][b]Alternative Textures (AT) and PIF - Personal Rooms versions: [/b]You can pick one or the other (or use both!).
[*][b]AT Version: [/b]Adds textures to the objects "Decorative Hatch" and "Decorative Oak/Walnut Ladder". [i][u]Does NOT give PIF functionality.[/u][/i]
[*][b]PIF Version: [/b]Adds 10 new Decorative Hatches, 7 new Decorative Ladders, and 4 new Attic Ladders as Dimension Doors. Additionally, [u]new items  appear in the Furniture Catalogue[/u] (purchased from Robin).
[*][b]Vanilla-Matching Swatches: [/b]Comes in Vanilla Walnut, Birch, Mahogany, Winter swatches and extras added in 1.6:﻿[spoiler]Wizard and Retro wood swatch, Junimo stone swatch (Decorative Hatch only), and Joja swatches (Metal and Blue)[/spoiler]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with Happy Home Designer.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. 
[*]If using the PIF variant, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].
[*]If using the AT variant, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the downloaded mod archive(s) into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]For instructions on using Dimension Doors, please refer to PIF - Personal Rooms.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

[size=3]Please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Modding Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response (don't forget to ping for bug reports!)
[/size]
Thank you to the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod and for everyone's encouraging comments!

[b][size=3][i]Mods used in screenshots:﻿
[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17912]VPR-Inspired UI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[/list][/b]
